label: def:brane-boundary
title: Defining boundary of the brane
html:
Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) be a quantum observable universe equipped with the recursive brane tower \{A_n\}_{n \geq 0} (recursive brane tower). Let \mathfrak{d}_{n+1} be the descent homomorphism (descent). The defining boundary of the n-th brane is the full subcategory of \mathbf{C} comprising subobjects of A_n where the restriction morphism r_n \colon A_n \to A_{n-1} has a non-trivial kernel:

  \partial A_n
  = 
  \bigl\{ S \hookrightarrow A_n \bigm|
    \ker(r_n|_S) \neq 0 \bigr\}.

In the archimedean realisation, \partial A_n corresponds to the geometric locus \partial \mathcal{S}_n = \{p \in \mathcal{S}_n \mid \ker(\mathfrak{d}_{n+1}|_p) \neq 0\} \subseteq \mathcal{S}_n, which exactly matches the degeneracy locus of the fibrewise descent map.
